<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">corporate tax rate resulted in a one-time charge to the Company&#8217;s earnings and reduction to its net deferred tax assets of approximately $</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002288" name="csfl:IncomeTaxReconciliationWriteDownOfDeferredTaxAssetDueToChangeInFederalIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="C_0001102266_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">18,575</ix:nonFraction></span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">which was recorded in 2017.</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In assessing the realizability of deferred tax assets, management considers whether it is more likely than not that some portion or all of the deferred tax assets will not be realized.&#160;&#160;In performing this analysis, the Company considers all evidence currently available, both positive and negative, in determining whether based on the weight of that evidence, it is more likely than not the deferred tax asset will be realized.&#160;&#160;Based on management&#8217;s analysis, it was determined that it is more likely than not that the net deferred tax asset, net of the one-time charge mentioned above, will be realized as of December 31, 2018 and 2017. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company and its subsidiaries are subject to U.S. federal income tax as well as income tax of the states of Florida, Georgia, Alabama, California, Colorado, North Carolina and Tennessee.&#160;&#160;CSFL Insurance Corp. files a tax return in South Carolina.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company is no longer subject to examination by taxing authorities for the years before 2015.&#160;&#160;The Company has not recorded any material interest or penalties on its income tax liabilities for the years 2018, 2017 and 2016. </p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(1</span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">7</span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">)</span></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">Regulatory Capital Matters </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company and the Bank are subject to various regulatory capital requirements administered by the federal banking agencies.&#160;&#160;Under capital adequacy guidelines and the regulatory framework for prompt corrective action, the Company and the Bank must meet specific capital guidelines that involve quantitative measures of assets, liabilities and certain off-balance-sheet items as calculated under regulatory accounting practices.&#160;&#160;The capital amounts and classification are also subject to qualitative judgments by the regulators about components, risk weightings and other factors.&#160;&#160;Failure to meet minimum capital requirements can initiate certain mandatory and possibly additional discretionary actions by regulators that, if undertaken, could have a direct material effect on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.&#160;&#160;The final rules implementing Basel Committee on Banking Supervision&#8217;s capital guidelines for U.S. banks (Basel III rules) became effective for the Company on January 1, 2015 with full compliance with all of the requirements being phased in over a multi-year schedule, and fully phased in by January 1, 2019.&#160;&#160; </p></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">122</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:6.61%;">&#160;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">CENTERSTATE BANK CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(Dollar amounts in thousands, except per share data)</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As of December&#160;31, 2018 and 2017, the most recent notifications from the Office of Comptroller of the Currency (&#8220;OCC&#8221;) categorized the Bank as &#8220;well capitalized&#8221; under the regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.&#160;&#160;To be categorized as &#8220;well capitalized,&#8221; the Bank must maintain total risk-based, Tier I risk-based, common equity Tier 1 risk-based and Tier I leverage ratios as set forth in the table.&#160;&#160;There are no conditions or events since that notification that management believes have changed the institution&#8217;s category.&#160;&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000746" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapitalRequirementsUnderBankingRegulationsTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001102266_20180101_20181231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000746_cnt_1">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Substantially all of the Company&#8217;s employees are covered under its 401(k) defined contribution retirement plan.&#160;&#160;Employees are eligible to participate in the plan after completing <ix:nonNumeric id="F_002658" name="csfl:MinimumEmployeeServicePeriodForPlanEligibility" contextRef="C_0001102266_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">six months</ix:nonNumeric> of continuous employment.&#160;&#160;The Company contributes an amount equal to a certain percentage of the employees&#8217; contributions based on the discretion of the Board of Directors.&#160;&#160;In addition, the Company may also make additional contributions to the plan each year, subject to profitability and other factors, and based solely on the discretion of the Board of Directors.&#160;&#160;For the years ended December&#160;31, 2018, 2017 and 2016, the Company&#8217;s contributions to the plan were $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002655" name="us-gaap:DefinedContributionPlanEmployerDiscretionaryContributionAmount" contextRef="C_0001102266_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">3,444</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002656" name="us-gaap:DefinedContributionPlanEmployerDiscretionaryContributionAmount" contextRef="C_0001102266_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">2,249</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002657" name="us-gaap:DefinedContributionPlanEmployerDiscretionaryContributionAmount" contextRef="C_0001102266_20160101_20161231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">1,849</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, which are included in Salary, Wages and Employee Benefits on the Consolidated Statements of Income and Comprehensive Income. <p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Commitments to make loans are generally made for periods of <ix:nonNumeric id="F_002797" name="csfl:FixedRateLoanCommitmentPeriod" contextRef="C_0001102266_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:durday">30</ix:nonNumeric> days or less.&#160;&#160;At December 31, 2018, the fixed rate loan commitments have interest rates ranging from <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_002798" name="csfl:LoanCommitmentsPercentageOfFixedInterestRate" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMinimumMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="4" scale="-2">3.27</ix:nonFraction>% to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_002799" name="csfl:LoanCommitmentsPercentageOfFixedInterestRate" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="4" scale="-2">8.35</ix:nonFraction>% and maturities ranging from <ix:nonNumeric id="F_002800" name="csfl:LoanCommitmentsFixedInterestRateMaturityTerm" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMinimumMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">1</ix:nonNumeric> year to <ix:nonNumeric id="F_002801" name="csfl:LoanCommitmentsFixedInterestRateMaturityTerm" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">20</ix:nonNumeric> years.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Because many commitments expire without being funded in whole or part, the contract amounts are not estimates of future cash flows. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Credit risk represents the accounting loss that would be recognized at the reporting date if counterparties failed completely to perform as contracted.&#160;&#160;The credit risk amounts are equal to the contractual amounts, assuming that the amounts are fully advanced and that the collateral or other security is of no value. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s policy is to require customers to provide collateral prior to the disbursement of approved loans.&#160;&#160;The amount of collateral obtained, if it is deemed necessary by the Company upon extension of credit, is based on management&#8217;s credit </p></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">130</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:6.61%;">&#160;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />

<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(Dollar amounts in thousands, except per share data)</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p><ix:continuation id="F_000656_dcnt_cfa8ae6e-aeb9-4a8a-a55f-5cb8a0a41b3f">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">evaluation of the counterparty.&#160;&#160;Collateral held varies but may include accounts receivable, inventory, real estate and income providing commercial properties. </span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Standby letters of credit are contractual commitments issued by the Company to guarantee the performance of a customer to a third party.&#160;&#160;The credit risk involved in issuing letters of credit is essentially the same as that involved in extending loan facilities to customers. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Outstanding commitments are deemed to approximate fair value due to the variable nature of the interest rates involved and the short-term nature of the commitments. </p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:6.61%;">&#160;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">CENTERSTATE BANK CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(Dollar amounts in thousands, except per share data)</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p><ix:continuation id="F_000659_dcnt_41ba3961-fb09-4efe-af9f-0cacdd8d20d7">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Commercial and retail banking</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">: The Company&#8217;s primary business is commercial and retail banking. Currently, the Company operates primarily through the Bank providing traditional retail, commercial, mortgage, wealth management and SBA services throughout its Florida, Georgia and Alabama branch network and customer relationships in neighboring states.</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Correspondent banking and capital markets division</span>:&#160;&#160;Operating as a division of our subsidiary bank, its primary revenue generating activities are related to the capital markets division which includes commissions earned on fixed income security sales, fees from hedging services, loan brokerage fees and consulting fees for services related to these activities. Income generated related to the correspondent banking services includes spread income earned on correspondent bank deposits (i.e. federal funds purchased) and fees generated from safe-keeping activities, bond accounting services, asset/liability consulting services, international wires, clearing and corporate checking account services and other correspondent banking related services. The fees derived from the correspondent banking services are less volatile than those generated through the capital markets group. The customer base includes small to medium size financial institutions primarily located in Southeastern United States. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Corporate overhead and administration</span>:&#160;&#160;Corporate overhead and administration is comprised primarily of compensation and benefits for certain members of management, interest on parent company debt, office occupancy and depreciation of parent company facilities, merger related costs and other expenses. </p></ix:continuation>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:-4.5%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:-4.5%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:9pt;">&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000660" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001102266_20180101_20181231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000660_dcnt_3652fe6a-026c-4800-86da-e185e814777d">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(26)<span style="margin-left:36pt;">Business C</span>ombinations </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Acquisition of Platinum Bank Holding Company</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On <ix:nonNumeric id="F_002957" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEffectiveDateOfAcquisition1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen">April 1, 2017</ix:nonNumeric>, the Company completed its acquisition of Platinum Bank Holding Company (&#8220;Platinum&#8221;) whereby Platinum merged with and into the Company. Pursuant to and simultaneously with the merger of Platinum with and into the Company, Platinum&#8217;s wholly owned subsidiary bank, Platinum Bank merged with and into the Company&#8217;s subsidiary bank, CenterState Bank, N.A. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s primary reasons for the transaction were to further solidify its market share in the Central Florida markets and expand its customer base to enhance deposit fee income and leverage operating cost through economies of scale. The acquisition increased the Company&#8217;s total assets and total deposits by approximately <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_002958" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInAssets" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20170331_20170401" decimals="2" scale="-2">14</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_002959" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInDeposits" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20170331_20170401" decimals="2" scale="-2">13</ix:nonFraction>%, respectively, as compared with the balances at December&#160;31, 2016, and is expected to positively affect the Company&#8217;s operating results to the extent the Company earns more from interest earning assets than it pays in interest on its interest bearing liabilities.&#160;&#160;<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002961" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" scale="3">No</ix:nonFraction> acquisition costs related to the Platinum acquisition were incurred during the twelve-month period ending December 31, 2018. During the twelve-month periods ending December 31, 2017 and 2016, the Company incurred approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002960" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">3,924</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002962" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20160101_20161231" decimals="-3" scale="3">186</ix:nonFraction> of acquisition costs related to this transaction, respectively. These acquisition costs are reported in Merger Related Expenses on the Company&#8217;s Consolidated Statements of Income and Comprehensive Income.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The acquisition was accounted for under the acquisition method of accounting in accordance with ASC Topic 805, <span style="font-style:italic;">Business Combinations</span>. The Company recognized goodwill on this acquisition of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002963" name="us-gaap:Goodwill" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20170401" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">73,829</ix:nonFraction> which is nondeductible for tax purposes as this acquisition is a nontaxable transaction. The goodwill is calculated based on the fair values of the assets acquired and liabilities assumed as of the acquisition date. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company acquired <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_002964" name="csfl:PercentageOfOutstandingStockAcquired" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_us-gaapEquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis_us-gaapCommonStockMember_20170331_20170401" decimals="INF" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the outstanding common stock of Platinum. The purchase price consisted of both cash and stock. Each share of Platinum common stock was exchanged for $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD_shares" id="F_002965" name="csfl:BusinessCombinationCashReceivedPerShareOfAcquireCommonStock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20170401" decimals="INF">7.60</ix:nonFraction> cash and <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_002966" name="csfl:BusinessCombinationCommonStockSharesExchangedPerShareOfAcquireCommonStock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20170401" decimals="4">3.7832</ix:nonFraction> shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock. Based on the closing price of the Company&#8217;s common stock on March 31, 2017, the resulting purchase price was $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_002967" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20170331_20170401" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">119,431</ix:nonFraction>.&#160;&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000759" name="csfl:ScheduleOfBusinessCombinationPurchasePriceAllocationTableTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_20180101_20181231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000759_dcnt_25682ebe-9019-4463-85d4-e99f54f8bf91">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><br /></p></ix:nonNumeric></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">133</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:6.61%;">&#160;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In its assumption of the deposit liabilities, the Company believed the deposits assumed from the acquisition have an intangible value. The Company applied ASC Topic 805, which prescribes the accounting for goodwill and other intangible assets such as core deposit intangibles, in a business combination. The Company determined the estimated fair value of the core deposit intangible asset totaled $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003027" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFairValueDisclosure" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20170401" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">3,992</ix:nonFraction>,<span style="color:#FF0000;"> </span>which will be amortized utilizing an accelerated amortization method over an estimated economic life not to exceed <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003028" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflPlatinumBankHoldingCompanyMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric>. In determining the valuation amount, deposits were analyzed based on factors such as type of deposit, deposit retention, interest rates and age of deposit relationships. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Acquisition of Gateway Financial Holdings of Florida, Inc.</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003029" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEffectiveDateOfAcquisition1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen">May 1, 2017</ix:nonNumeric>, the Company completed its acquisition of Gateway Financial Holdings of Florida, Inc. (&#8220;Gateway&#8221;) Gateway merged with and into the Company.&#160;&#160;Pursuant to and simultaneously with the merger of Gateway with and into the Company, Gateway&#8217;s three subsidiary banks, Gateway Bank of Florida, Gateway Bank of Central Florida and Gateway Bank of Southwest Florida, merged with and into the Company&#8217;s subsidiary bank, CenterState Bank, N.A </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s primary reasons for the transaction were to expand its market share in the Central Florida market, together with its acquisition of Platinum as described above, and expand its customer base to enhance deposit fee income and leverage operating cost through economies of scale. The acquisition increased the Company&#8217;s total assets and total deposits by approximately <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003030" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInAssets" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_20170430_20170501" decimals="2" scale="-2">19</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003031" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInDeposits" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_20170430_20170501" decimals="2" scale="-2">17</ix:nonFraction>%, respectively, as compared with the balances at December 31, 2016, and is expected to positively affect the Company&#8217;s operating results to the extent the Company earns more from interest earning assets than it pays in interest on its interest bearing liabilities.&#160;&#160;During the twelve-month periods ending December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016, the Company incurred approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003033" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" scale="3">149</ix:nonFraction> , $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003032" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">6,203</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003034" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_20160101_20161231" decimals="-3" scale="3">11</ix:nonFraction> of acquisition costs related to this transaction, respectively. These acquisition costs are reported in Merger Related Expenses on the Company&#8217;s Consolidated Statements of Income and Comprehensive Income. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The acquisition was accounted for under the acquisition method of accounting in accordance with ASC Topic 805, <span style="font-style:italic;">Business Combinations</span>. The Company recognized goodwill on this acquisition of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003035" name="us-gaap:Goodwill" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_20170501" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">77,826</ix:nonFraction> which is nondeductible for tax purposes as this acquisition is a nontaxable transaction. The goodwill is calculated based on the fair values of the assets acquired and liabilities assumed as of the acquisition date. </p></ix:continuation>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">135</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:6.61%;">&#160;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In its assumption of the deposit liabilities, the Company believed the deposits assumed from the acquisition have an intangible value. The Company applied ASC Topic 805, which prescribes the accounting for goodwill and other intangible assets such as core deposit intangibles, in a business combination. The Company determined the estimated fair value of the core deposit intangible asset totaled $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003106" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFairValueDisclosure" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20170501" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">8,432</ix:nonFraction>, which will be amortized utilizing an accelerated amortization method over an estimated economic life not to exceed <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003107" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflGatewayFinancialHoldingsOfFloridaIncMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric>. In determining the valuation amount, deposits were analyzed based on factors such as type of deposit, deposit retention, interest rates and age of deposit relationships.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Acquisition of Sunshine Bancorp, Inc.</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003108" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEffectiveDateOfAcquisition1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20180101" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen">January 1, 2018</ix:nonNumeric>, the Company completed its acquisition of Sunshine Bancorp, Inc. (&#8220;Sunshine&#8221;) whereby Sunshine merged with and into the Company. Pursuant to and simultaneously with the merger of Sunshine with and into the Company, Sunshine&#8217;s wholly owned subsidiary bank, Sunshine Bank merged with and into the Company&#8217;s subsidiary bank, CenterState Bank, N.A. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s primary reasons for the transaction were to further solidify its market share in the Florida market and expand its customer base to enhance deposit fee income and leverage operating cost through economies of scale.&#160;&#160;The acquisition increased the Company&#8217;s total assets and total deposits by approximately <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003109" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInAssets" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="2" scale="-2">14</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003110" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInDeposits" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="2" scale="-2">13</ix:nonFraction>%, respectively, as compared with the balances at December&#160;31, 2017, and is expected to positively affect the Company&#8217;s operating results to the extent the Company earns more from interest earning assets than it pays in interest on its interest bearing liabilities.&#160;&#160;During the twelve-month periods ending December 31, 2018 and 2017, the Company incurred approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003111" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">10,474</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003112" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" scale="3">859</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, of acquisition costs related to this transaction. A portion of these merger expenses reduced goodwill by $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003113" name="us-gaap:GoodwillPeriodIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" sign="-" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3"><ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003114" name="us-gaap:GoodwillPeriodIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" sign="-" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">4,114</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>, net of income taxes of <span>$<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003115" name="csfl:IncomeTaxExpenseRelatedToGoodwill" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3"><ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003116" name="csfl:IncomeTaxExpenseRelatedToGoodwill" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">1,397</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span>. These acquisition costs are reported in Merger Related Expenses on the Company&#8217;s Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income and Comprehensive Income.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The acquisition was accounted for under the acquisition method of accounting in accordance with ASC Topic 805, <span style="font-style:italic;">Business Combinations</span>. The Company recognized goodwill on this acquisition of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003117" name="us-gaap:Goodwill" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">114,228</ix:nonFraction> which is nondeductible for tax purposes as this acquisition is a nontaxable transaction. The goodwill is calculated based on the fair values of the assets acquired and liabilities assumed as of the acquisition date. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company acquired <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003118" name="csfl:PercentageOfOutstandingStockAcquired" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_us-gaapEquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis_us-gaapCommonStockMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="INF" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the outstanding common stock of Sunshine. The purchase price consisted of stock plus cash in lieu of fractional shares. Each share of Sunshine common stock was exchanged for <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003119" name="csfl:BusinessCombinationCommonStockSharesExchangedPerShareOfAcquireCommonStock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101" decimals="2">0.89</ix:nonFraction> shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock. Based on the closing price of the Company&#8217;s common stock on December 29, 2017, the resulting purchase price was $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003120" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">187,852</ix:nonFraction>.&#160;&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000767" name="csfl:ScheduleOfBusinessCombinationPurchasePriceAllocationTableTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_20180101_20181231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000767_dcnt_69053f14-1836-4c72-b837-65abf613b7fc">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The table below summarizes the purchase price calculation. </p></ix:nonNumeric></ix:continuation>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In its assumption of the deposit liabilities, the Company believed the deposits assumed from the acquisition have an intangible value. The Company applied ASC Topic 805, which prescribes the accounting for goodwill and other intangible assets such as core deposit intangibles, in a business combination. The Company determined the estimated fair value of the core deposit intangible asset totaled $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003179" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFairValueDisclosure" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20180101" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">8,525</ix:nonFraction>,<span style="color:#FF0000;"> </span>which will be amortized utilizing an accelerated amortization method over an estimated economic life not to exceed <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003180" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflSunshineBancorpIncMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric>. In determining the valuation amount, deposits were analyzed based on factors such as type of deposit, deposit retention, interest rates and age of deposit relationships.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Acquisition of HCBF Holding Company, Inc.</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003181" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEffectiveDateOfAcquisition1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101_20180101" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen">January 1, 2018</ix:nonNumeric>, the Company completed its acquisition of HCBF Holding Company, Inc. (&#8220;HCBF&#8221;) whereby HCBF merged with and into the Company. Pursuant to and simultaneously with the merger of HCBF with and into the Company, HCBF&#8217;s wholly owned subsidiary bank, Harbor Bank merged with and into the Company&#8217;s subsidiary bank, CenterState Bank, N.A. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s primary reasons for the transaction were to further solidify its market share in the Florida market and expand its customer base to enhance deposit fee income and leverage operating cost through economies of scale.&#160;&#160;The acquisition increased the Company&#8217;s total assets and total deposits by approximately <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003182" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInAssets" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="2" scale="-2">33</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003183" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInDeposits" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="2" scale="-2">32</ix:nonFraction>%, respectively, as compared with the balances at December&#160;31, 2017, and is expected to positively affect the Company&#8217;s operating results to the extent the Company earns more from interest earning assets than it pays in interest on its interest bearing liabilities.&#160;&#160;During the twelve-month periods ending December 31, 2018 and 2017, the Company incurred approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003184" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">12,302</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003185" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">2,060</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, of acquisition costs related to this transaction. These acquisition costs are reported in Merger Related Expenses on the Company&#8217;s Consolidated Statements of Income and Comprehensive Income.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The acquisition was accounted for under the acquisition method of accounting in accordance with ASC Topic 805, <span style="font-style:italic;">Business Combinations</span>. The Company recognized goodwill on this acquisition of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003186" name="us-gaap:Goodwill" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">233,321</ix:nonFraction> which is nondeductible for tax purposes as this acquisition is a nontaxable transaction. The goodwill is calculated based on the fair values of the assets acquired and liabilities assumed as of the acquisition date. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company acquired <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003187" name="csfl:PercentageOfOutstandingStockAcquired" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_us-gaapEquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis_us-gaapCommonStockMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="INF" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the outstanding common stock of HCBF. The purchase price consisted of both cash and stock. Each share of HCBF common stock was exchanged for $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD_shares" id="F_003188" name="csfl:BusinessCombinationCashReceivedPerShareOfAcquireCommonStock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101" decimals="INF">1.925</ix:nonFraction> cash and <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003189" name="csfl:BusinessCombinationCommonStockSharesExchangedPerShareOfAcquireCommonStock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101" decimals="3">0.675</ix:nonFraction> shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock. Based on the closing price of the Company&#8217;s common stock on December 29, 2017, the resulting purchase price was $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003190" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_20180101_20180101" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">448,236</ix:nonFraction>.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.5%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.5%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In its assumption of the deposit liabilities, the Company believed the deposits assumed from the acquisition have an intangible value. The Company applied ASC Topic 805, which prescribes the accounting for goodwill and other intangible assets such as core deposit intangibles, in a business combination. The Company determined the estimated fair value of the core deposit intangible asset totaled $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003254" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFairValueDisclosure" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20180101" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">23,625</ix:nonFraction>,<span style="color:#FF0000;"> </span>which will be amortized utilizing an accelerated amortization method over an estimated economic life not to exceed <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003255" name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife" contextRef="C_0001102266_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflHCBFHoldingCompanyIncMember_us-gaapFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_us-gaapCoreDepositsMember_20180101_20181231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric>. In determining the valuation amount, deposits were analyzed based on factors such as type of deposit, deposit retention, interest rates and age of deposit relationships.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.5%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.5%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Acquisition of Charter Financial Corporation</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003256" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEffectiveDateOfAcquisition1" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflCharterFinancialCorporationMember_20180831_20180901" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen">September 1, 2018</ix:nonNumeric>, the Company completed its acquisition of Charter Financial Corporation (&#8220;Charter&#8221;) whereby Charter merged with and into the Company. Pursuant to and simultaneously with the merger of Charter with and into the Company, Charter&#8217;s wholly owned subsidiary bank, CharterBank, merged with and into the Company&#8217;s subsidiary bank, CenterState Bank, N.A. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s primary reasons for the transaction were to expand its franchise into Georgia and Alabama, further solidify its market share in the Florida market and expand its customer base to enhance deposit fee income and leverage operating cost through economies of scale.&#160;&#160;The acquisition increased the Company&#8217;s total assets and total deposits by approximately <span><ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003257" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInAssets" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflCharterFinancialCorporationMember_20180831_20180901" decimals="2" scale="-2"><ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003258" name="csfl:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseInDeposits" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflCharterFinancialCorporationMember_20180831_20180901" decimals="2" scale="-2">24</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>%</span> as compared with the balances at December&#160;31, 2017, and is expected to positively affect the Company&#8217;s operating results to the extent the Company earns more from interest earning assets than it pays in interest on its interest bearing liabilities.&#160;&#160;During the twelve-month period ending December 31, 2018, the Company incurred approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003259" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflCharterFinancialCorporationMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">11,987</ix:nonFraction> of acquisition costs related to this transaction. These acquisition costs are reported in Merger Related Expenses on the Company&#8217;s Consolidated Statements of Income and Comprehensive Income.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The acquisition was accounted for under the acquisition method of accounting in accordance with ASC Topic 805, <span style="font-style:italic;">Business Combinations</span>. The Company recognized goodwill on this acquisition of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003260" name="us-gaap:Goodwill" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflCharterFinancialCorporationMember_20180901" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">197,648</ix:nonFraction> which is nondeductible for tax purposes as this acquisition is a nontaxable transaction. The goodwill is calculated based on the fair values of the assets acquired and liabilities assumed as of the acquisition date. Fair value estimates are based on the information available, and are subject to change for up to <ix:nonNumeric id="F_003261" name="csfl:FairValueEstimatesDeterminationPeriod" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflCharterFinancialCorporationMember_20180831_20180901" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">one year</ix:nonNumeric> after the closing date of the acquisition as additional information relative to closing date fair values becomes available.&#160;&#160; </p></ix:continuation>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">CENTERSTATE BANK CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(Dollar amounts in thousands, except per share data)</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p><ix:continuation id="F_000660_dcnt_b60af6e7-e222-4121-915d-ae524ba45675">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-size:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The disclosures regarding the results of operations for Community, Hometown, Platinum, Gateway, Sunshine, HCBF and Charter subsequent to their respective acquisition dates are omitted as this information is not practical to obtain.&#160;&#160;The Company converted Community, Hometown, Platinum, Gateway, and Sunshine&#8217;s core systems in the same quarter as their respective acquisition date. Although the Company did not convert HCBF&#8217;s core system in the first quarter of 2018 or Charter&#8217;s core system in the third quarter of 2018, the majority of the fixed costs and purchase accounting entries were booked on the Company&#8217;s core system making it impractical to determine HCBF or Charter&#8217;s results of operation on a stand-alone basis.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Announced Acquisition of National Commerce Corporation</span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On November 23, 2018, the Company entered into a definitive agreement to acquire National Commerce Corporation (&#8220;NCC&#8221;), whereby NCC will merge with and into the Company, with the Company continuing as the surviving corporation in the merger.&#160;&#160;Immediately after the merger, the Company&#8217;s subsidiary bank and NCC&#8217;s subsidiary bank, National Bank of Commerce (&#8220;NBC&#8221;), will merge with CenterState Bank as the surviving bank.&#160;&#160;Under the terms of the agreement, each outstanding share of NCC common stock will convert into the right to receive <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_pure" id="F_003339" name="csfl:BusinessCombinationCommonStockSharesExchangedPerShareOfAcquireCommonStock" contextRef="C_0001102266_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_csflNationalCommerceCorporationMember_20181123" decimals="2">1.65</ix:nonFraction> shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock, provided that cash in lieu of any fractional shares of CenterState common stock will be paid.&#160;&#160;The transaction was unanimously approved by the boards of directors of both companies. The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of 2019 subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of all applicable regulatory approvals and shareholder approval of the Company and stockholder approval of NCC. The Company&#8217;s primary reasons for the transaction are to expand its core growth markets of Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville and Atlanta, further solidify its market share in Florida, Georgia and Alabama, expand its customer base to enhance deposit fee income and leverage operating cost through economies of scale.&#160;&#160;NCC, which is headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, operates <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_csflLocation" id="F_003340" name="csfl:NumberOfServiceBankingLocations" contextRef="C_0001102266_deiLegalEntityAxis_csflNationalCommerceCorporationMember_20180101_20181231" decimals="INF">37</ix:nonFraction> banking locations.&#160;&#160;As of December 31, 2018, NCC reported total assets of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003341" name="us-gaap:Assets" contextRef="C_0001102266_deiLegalEntityAxis_csflNationalCommerceCorporationMember_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">4,210,541</ix:nonFraction>, total loans of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003342" name="us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmount" contextRef="C_0001102266_deiLegalEntityAxis_csflNationalCommerceCorporationMember_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">3,317,965</ix:nonFraction> and total deposits of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_003343" name="us-gaap:Deposits" contextRef="C_0001102266_deiLegalEntityAxis_csflNationalCommerceCorporationMember_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">3,432,289</ix:nonFraction>. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</p></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000661" name="us-gaap:DerivativesAndFairValueTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001102266_20180101_20181231" escape="true">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:4.5%;text-indent:-4.5%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000662" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001102266_20180101_20181231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000662_dcnt_351b5290-1676-44e7-967a-7b67cf0bbec1">
